title: Airspeed Indicator
description: An aircraft airspeed indicator with colored arcs and a red line. The needle follows a live reading and turns red on overspeed.
about: `ui.ias`, a value only the panel shows, drives the needle through `--value`. `ui.overspeed` flips the needle red with `:has()`. **Zero pitot** is a `<button name="tare">` the phase reads with `ui.pressed("tare")`.

title: Battery Pack Charge
description: State of charge, current, temperature and all eight cells live while a LiFePO4 pack charges and balances.
about: The pack's state of charge fills the battery shape with `height: calc(var(--value) * 1%)`. Each cell is a bar on `ui.cell_N`. The three results at the bottom bind measurements, so they turn green or red with `data-outcome` once recorded.

title: Power Rails Fixture
description: A board drawing whose test points light up as the probe moves, each turning green or red with its rail's result.
about: `ui.probe` names the test point under the probe, and the board's `data-value` rings it. Each rail is a measurement recorded as soon as it settles, so its pad turns green or red with `data-outcome` on the drawing.

title: Motor Spin Test
description: Speed and current arc gauges for a drone motor and ESC, with each throttle setpoint lit as the sweep reaches it.
about: The arc gauges are SVG paths with `pathLength="100"` and a `stroke-dasharray` computed from `--value`. Each setpoint lights with `opacity: clamp(.18, var(--value) - var(--n) + 1, 1)`, with no JavaScript.

title: Cooling Fan Test
description: Fan blades and airflow lines on looping CSS animations that start and stop with the run, next to live speed and airflow readings.
about:
The blades and the airflow lines loop on fixed `@keyframes`, declared `paused`. The phase sets `ui.running = True`, and the panel's root, bound with `data-bind="ui.running"`, switches them to `animation-play-state: running` with `[data-value=true]`. The phase never drives the motion: it only sends the readings and records the measurements.

The keyframes carry the example's name (`fan-test-spin`, `fan-test-flow`, `fan-test-blink`), so they stay distinct when you copy them into a panel of your own. Readers who prefer reduced motion see the panel still.
